from: Frame**: a data table of named, typed columns. A column leaves it as a typed list with Get Column. A row leaves as a one-row Frame, since a row mixes types.

from: Cube**: a Frame whose cells hold whole Frames: each Customer holding its own table of Orders, without flattening to one wide sheet.
